question: Do the three original RNA/endothelial/ASPS publications contain source-authenticated native EMC or LGFMS conditions/control RNA inputs, or already establish the proposed GPNMB EMC-versus-LGFMS comparative association?
use: Resolve potentially consequential original-source prior-art/coverage gaps for the independently useful narrow native RNA comparison. A broad target/RNA association is not automatically the same comparator/use; title or ASPS labels alone do not exclude eligible broader controls.
strongest_alternative: An embedded EMC/LGFMS tissue/control group, reused cohort, mixed compartment, vascular-selected gene assay or already published exact comparison could alter interpretation or novelty. Generic histology or source similarity cannot authenticate cases.
disproof: An already reported equivalent comparative finding defeats novelty; a new suitable native input remains mandatory and would require meaningful fixed all-condition assay-specific evaluation before quantities. Unsuitable controls or absent authenticated source identity cannot be converted into a biological negative.
source_selection_rule: Read prior exact evaluations/cache hashes and failed routes first; at most4 genuinely new ordinary official source or metadata calls,10s each. Freeze exact route before call; no alternate article after access denial, no publisher retry or guessed source.
field_mask: Ordinary RNA platform/gene or probe identity/units/processed-source schema
Separable primary comparative finding relevant to RNA use
excluded: FAP tissue/glycan/HLA/structural-genomics/fusion-topology/mechanism/sequence/CNA/STR/inferred malignant classes/private/login/UI/spend/GPU/outreach/publication/PR/external writes. No new target/comparator/ranking/core statistic.
new_value_rule: No quantities in initial source gate. If genuinely additional source-authenticated ready GPNMB input emerges, freeze useful fixed contrast/prior art/units/all conditions/control/overlap/strongest alternative/disproof and coordinate challenge before evaluating permitted ordinary RNA quantities.
prior_exposure: Core and culture GPNMB outcomes known; no blinding claim; old freezes and failures preserved.
